label: positive
description: OZ 5 equivalent of P1-02. withdraw() loses its onlyRole(TREASURER_ROLE) constraint on an AccessControlUpgradeable (v5.7.0) contract, with no replacement; any caller can drain ETH held by the Treasury to an arbitrary address.
why_labeled: A value-moving function that required TREASURER_ROLE at N-1 has no access control at N. In OZ 5 the role check resolves through AccessControlUpgradeable.onlyRole -> _checkRole(role) -> _checkRole(role, _msgSender()), which reads role membership from the ERC-7201 AccessControlStorage namespace. Its removal widens the caller set from role-holders to everyone; value moves, so this is a CONFIRMED SC01 regression that Rule 1 must fire on, resolving the constraint through OZ 5's namespaced _checkRole.
why_oz5_matters: Confirms Rule 1 resolves an onlyRole msg.sender constraint through OZ 5's namespaced AccessControl storage, the AccessControl analogue of the OwnableUpgradeable indirection.
